subject_definitions:
<Video 1>: The complete source video to edit and the reference for all original motion.
summary:
[video editing] Change only the main performer's black dress to bright red, preserving its shape, white collar and cuffs, and existing ribbon. Preserve the same person, face, hair, accessories, skin, body proportions, room, objects, background, camera, composition and all original motion. Preserve every original gesture, expression, action order, speed, timing and rhythm. Keep the same realistic live-action appearance.
retention_analysis:
<Video 1>: Preserve source motion, action timing, person, objects, camera and background; apply only the requested appearance change.
detailed_description:
Preserve the original source actions, their order, timing and rhythm. Keep the source playback speed, camera and duration. In particular, preserve the single brief right-hand V-shaped face-framing gesture around 2.08–2.75 seconds: the right hand approaches the eye/face, briefly forms the V beside or across the face, then moves away into the arm spread. Preserve the concurrently bent and lifted leg. Keep this local gesture between the preceding bent-knee stepping and arm pointing or sweep and the following overhead arm movement and broad sideways spread. Keep all these original actions at their original times; do not skip, merge, prolong, repeat or move the brief face gesture, and do not damage the surrounding rhythm.
overall_soundscape:
No speech or added sound effects are requested.
non_diegetic_music:
None.
